Definition: from G1181; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth:--pay (receive) tithes.
BiblicalUsage: To tithe is to give the tenth, and the word appears twice in Hebrews, both times of Abraham and Melchizedek: he who received the tithes blessed him who had the promises, and Levi, who receives tithes, paid tithes in Abraham. The tithe is the lesser blessing the greater.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tithe honours the greater: Abraham gave to one greater than himself, and we give to the One who is greater still.
